From our CEO: You'd insure your car. You'd insure your house. You'd insure your business.
So why is the most valuable thing you own — your freelance reputation — sitting unprotected?
Every five-star review you've ever earned. Every client who's ever vouched for you. Every project that took months of late nights. All of it lives on a platform you don't own. And it can vanish overnight. No appeal. No human to talk to. Just gone.
I built LanceRank to fix that.
It's not another marketplace. It's not competing with Upwork or Fiverr. It's a backup. A safety net. We pull in your verified reviews and projects from every platform you work on — and lock them into one profile that's yours. Forever.
It's 100% free. Always will be. No catch. No upsell. No cut of your work.
Because we built this for freelancers — not to start another business.
You're not just a freelancer. You're a business. It's time to protect yourself like one.
Verified. Trusted. Yours. 🛡️
